title: Dropping a colour on a swatch says nothing back
goal: Drag a text style over some text and a sentence appears in a pill under the pointer saying exactly what letting go would do. Drag a colour onto a swatch and the same sentence is worked out, but nobody ever sees it: the swatch only lights up. The colour drop should speak up the way the text style drop does.
notes:
Reproduced on 2026-09-12 with Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/mixed-part-keeps-its-colour-walk.json --no-build. The hold capture 2-colour-over-the-swatch-sc.png shows the Fill swatch lit with a blue ring and no sentence anywhere in the window.

The sentence exists: ColorDrop.answer(...).note. Sources/Photonz/ColorSwatchDrag.swift:84, LibraryColorDrop.swift:52 and OffPartColorDrop.swift:45 and :150 hang it on .accessibilityValue only, with a comment saying a tip does not show while a drag is in the air. The text style equivalent is drawn: StyleRowDropNote in Sources/Photonz/InspectorSections.swift:222 for the panel, CanvasTextStyleDrop.swift:141 for the canvas pill.

The playtest dragColor step has no "says" field, so no walk can pin the colour sentence today; dragTile does (Sources/PhotonzCore/PlaytestScript.swift:1503). Adding the same field is part of this.
acceptance: Holding a colour over a swatch shows the sentence the app already worked out, near the swatch and not over it
It says the same thing for one layer and for several, and it says why when the drop is refused
A playtest walk photographs the line with two layers selected, and the picture shows the words
